heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy. A rising chance of showers mid to late afternoon in the St. Lawrence Valley, slight chance farther south in New York, and farther east near the Québec border. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s; some upper 70s in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. Southeast winds 5 to 15 mph, becoming south and gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely, with a few embedded thunderstorms. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60 east of the Greens, upper 50s to mid 60s west. South to southeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. Scattered morning showers or a rumble of thunder, becoming widely scattered in the afternoon. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, except mid 70s to around 80 in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys. South to southeast winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming southwest in areas west of the Greens.
